answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fake-identity behaviour, like layers of shale that only form under sustained pressure over time. A new identity starts at its nadir, with no reputation and tiny transaction limits, and must earn trust through verified, useful work recorded across the nebula of independent verifiers before limits rise. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, while honest agents recover their stake, so mass forgery becomes unprofitable.
